pulses.name: Weaponizing the Protectors: TeamPCPs Multi-Stage Supply Chain Attack on Security Infrastructure
pulses.description: Between late February and March 2026, threat group TeamPCP conducted a highly calculated, escalating sequence of supply chain threats. It systematically compromised widely trusted open-source security tools, including the vulnerability scanners Trivy and KICS and the popular AI gateway LiteLLM. The affected software also includes the official Python SDK of Telnyx.
